abstract.p: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for generating modified cells with nucleic acid encoding a T cell receptor (TCR), a nucleic acid encoding a bispecific antibody, affinity molecule chimeric receptor, bispecific affinity molecule, or a chimeric ligand engineered activation receptor (CLEAR). One aspect includes a method for generating a modified T cell. Also included are methods and pharmaceutical compositions comprising the modified T cell for adoptive therapy and treating a condition, such as an autoimmune disease.
